name: v9_holiday_regression_seed_eval
readme: README.md in this folder. Section 8 lists every key; sections 2 and 6 define the metrics, the gates and how to produce a run.

v8.text: production create_text_representation (with Document ID / Shelf Mark lines)
v8.query: exact cosine script_score over all records

fusion.definition: reciprocal-rank fusion, k=60, equal weights, over the top 100 of: v8 cosine, v9 cosine, BM25 on genizah_merged_v9 (all records, production build_keyword_text_query with fields transcription_full_text^3, translation_full_text^2.5, description^2, title^2.5, document_type^1.5, content_type^1.5, collection^1.2, language^1.2, script_type^1.1, material^1; no alt_titles, no alias expansion, no duplicate collapsing). Offline simulation, not served (synth/syn_fusion.py; provenance only, deleted with the diagnosis scratchpad). The site measures the fusion and the default gate itself; the Studio does not need to reproduce it.

protocol.query_prompt:
Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve relevant passages
Query:
protocol.v8_v9_lists: live API POST /search {query, num_results: 20, include_embeddings: true} on 2026-10-08; v9 requested with index_name: genizah_merged_v9 (the response reported semantic_beta: true). The returned query vectors re-scored locally with the production script_score reproduced the live top 20 in 108 of 108 runs. Not repeatable through the API since 2026-10-08 (beta switch hidden); reproduce with the embedder plus ES script_score below.
protocol.metric: P@10; missing or unjudged ranks count as non-relevant
protocol.relevance: a record is relevant to a query when it is in the UNION of the v8 and v9 silver lists of the query's set for that rule (the rule is applied to each index's own description + alt_titles)

rules.strict: topic named in description or alt_titles, outside tractate / law-code context
rules.broad: strict + tractate-context mentions + same-name tractates (Pesahim, Sukkah)
rules.desc_strict: topic named in description only (what the result card shows), outside tractate context

caveats: regex silver labels (automatic, not human judgements): some passing mentions in letters, some personal names

resolution: one query's 0.1 step moves the 44-query holiday mean by 0.0023. Sampling noise is far larger: the paired per-query strict P@10 difference has mean -0.030, sd 0.352, SE 0.053 for v9 - v8 (W/L/T 14/17/13), and +0.050, SE 0.029 for fusion - v8 (20/9/15). The v9 - v8 strict headline is within noise; desc_strict (-0.411, SE 0.046) and the per-query collapses (Purim, Passover, Pesah, פסח) are not. score prints these paired figures for any run.
protocol.query_embedding: query_prompt + query, embedded raw (pass the prefix explicitly, never prompt_name='query'), L2-normalised, max_seq_length 8192
protocol.run_file_keys: exact queries[].query strings, including the Hebrew ones and both 'simchat torah' and 'Simchat Torah' (two separate queries)

other_metrics_definitions.R@100: CAPPED recall = relevant in top 100 / min(|relevant attainable in that index|, 100). Equals P@100 when a set has more than 100 relevant records, which 7 of the 9 holiday sets do (strict union: Pesach 435, Sukkot 488, Yom Kippur 318, Rosh Hashanah 196, Shavuot 151, Simchat Torah 122, Purim 113). Not comparable with the frozen eval's R@100, which is true recall.
other_metrics_definitions.MRR@100: reciprocal rank of the first relevant hit within the top 100, else 0

relevance_rules.text: fold(description) for desc_strict; fold(description) + ' || ' + fold(' || '.join(alt_titles)) otherwise
relevance_rules.fold: unicodedata NFKD, drop category Mn, replace [ʿʾ’‘ʼ`´] with ', lowercase

relevance_rules.implementation: regenerate_silver.py build_sets(), a verbatim copy of the diagnosis' holiday_eval/silver.py (provenance only, deleted with the diagnosis scratchpad). It reproduced the lists below exactly.

aggregates.note: mean P@10 over queries; relevant = union of the v8 and v9 silver lists for the query's set and rule

tractate_lawcode_share_top10.definition: holiday broad P@10 - strict P@10. Counts only hits whose festival mention sits in tractate / law-code context (Talmud, Mishnah, Rif, Mishneh Torah, Rambam, הלכות ...) plus the same-name tractates Pesahim and Sukkah. It does NOT count scripture hits (Bible: Esther / Numbers / Exodus) or 'Talmud Bavli: Megillah' for Purim, which name no festival at all

top20_record_style.definition: share of the 44 holiday queries' top-20 slots by catalogue style of the hit. canon = an alt_titles entry starting (case-insensitive) with Bible:, Talmud, Mishnah, Mishnaic, Isaac al-Fasi, Moses b. Maimon, Tosefta, Commentary on Mishnah, מקרא:, תלמוד, משנה, יצחק אלפסי or תוספתא, or a description containing '[טקסט' or 'הלכות הרי"ף' or starting 'משנה תורה'; stub = other Hebrew-only description of at most 120 characters; prose = everything else
top20_record_style.source: provenance only, deleted with the diagnosis scratchpad: holiday_eval/style_stats.py

paired_vs_v8_strict_p10_holiday.note: per-query differences over the 44 holiday queries; the v9 - v8 strict difference is within noise

acceptance.note: Proposed thresholds (Isaac, the site owner, confirms them). Scored with regenerate_silver.py score; relevance = union of the seed's v8/v9 lists and the new index's own lists (build); the seed's v8 top-10 lists are re-scored on the same union for the drop metrics. NOT MEASURED counts as FAIL. Thresholds are point values: B1 and D4 equal a baseline exactly, so one hit lost on one query fails them; read B1 / D1 / D5 with the paired SE (about 0.05 for a model-vs-v8 strict P@10 difference) in mind. 'baseline_metrics' are today's values for the three systems, from the top-10 lists in 'queries'; v8 itself fails B3 / D1 / D3 and the planned site fusion fails B6 / D2 / D5 / D6 / D7.

beta.applies_to: re-enabling the opt-in beta on a new model: the MODEL ALONE (exact cosine, semantic_eligible filter, top 10)

criteria.why: no holiday loss vs v8 (v9 today 0.657)
records that name the holiday only in Description must come back (v8 0.489, v9 0.077)
keep v9's gain on catalogue-labelled records (v9 0.802, v8 0.755)
no single holiday collapses (v9 today: Purim -0.467, Pesach -0.300)
no bare-name query collapses (v9 today: Purim -1.0, Passover -0.7, פסח -0.8)
share of relevant top-10 hits that name the holiday only in alt_titles (v8 0.288, v9 0.882); only 19.9% of eligible v9 records have alt_titles at all
distinct semantic_text_hash values in the top 10 (v9 today 7.80 by tied cosines); needs semantic_text_hash in the run

default.applies_to: switching the site default from v8: the ranking that would actually serve the default (model alone, or the site's fusion without v8). The model alone must also pass the beta gate.

criteria.why: no holiday worse than v8 beyond noise
bare names at most one or two hits worse than v8

definitions.bare-name query: holiday query of form english, transliterated, hebrew, ashkenazi or typo (32 of 44; regenerate_silver.BARE_NAME_FORMS); bare_name_max_drop = max over them of v8 P@10 - run P@10 (strict)
definitions.holiday-set drop: per holiday set, mean strict P@10 of v8 minus mean of the run over that set's queries; max_set_drop = the largest over the 9 sets
definitions.alt_titles-only share: of the strict-relevant top-10 hits over the 44 holiday queries, the share whose description does not name the holiday (it is named only in alt_titles)
definitions.distinct text groups: distinct semantic_text_hash values in the top 10, averaged over the 44 holiday queries

probes.note: Single-text probes, run 2026-10-08 on the live embedders (v8 :8001, v9 :8002): query embedded in query mode (prompt prefix), document text embedded in document mode (raw). Cosine of L2-normalised vectors. Re-run them on any new checkpoint. Pass rules: acceptance.manual_probes.

supplementary_proxy_set.note: Second 54-query set from the eval cross-check (provenance only, deleted with the diagnosis scratchpad: proxy_eval.py): the frozen eval's own Pesach / Rosh Hashanah / Sukkot name variants and probe queries (concept_probe_v1.json) plus the owner's queries. DIFFERENT relevance rule ('lenient'): a hit counts when title, description or alt_titles matches the topic regex below, case-insensitive, tractates INCLUDED (so 'Passover' -> Talmud: Pesahim counts). Query vectors came straight from the v8 (:8001) and v9 (:8002) embedders, exact cosine on the same indexes, top 20. Not comparable with the main set's numbers; use it for the extra name forms (Peysakh, Rosh Hashono, Succoth, Feast of Booths, pointed Hebrew) and the probe paraphrases.

silver.note: Shape: {set: {index_name: {strict, broad, desc_strict[, ineligible_strict]}}}, each a sorted doc_id list built by regenerate_silver.py build over that index's own description + alt_titles. ineligible_strict (v9 only) = strict records with semantic_eligible false. Relevance for scoring is the UNION over indexes for the query's set and rule (score adds any --silver file built for a new index).
